leadText: Masanori (Japanese: マサノリ) is a Warlord in Pokémon Conquest. He is friends with two other Warlords, Kiyomasa and Mitsunari.
plainText:
Masanori (Japanese: マサノリ) is a Warlord in Pokémon Conquest. He is friends with two other Warlords, Kiyomasa and Mitsunari.

==In the games==
 
 

===Warlord information===
====Rank I====
 

====Rank II====
 , Kiyomasa, Mitsunari, Masanori, Shingen, and Oichi having a feast]]
 
 

Transforms to Rank II by reaching a 60% link with Krokorok or Krookodile.

===Default Pokémon===
 
 
===Links===
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
====Unobtainable links====
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

===Quotes===
Start of turn:
When asleep:
"Get up, I said!"
With low health or a status ailment:
"Arrgh, this isn't looking so hot!"
When victory is near:
"Looks like they're finished!"
Otherwise:
"Yeahhh!"

Start of battle:
When attacking a castle:
"I'm going straight to the top!"
When defending a castle:
"No way we're giving up this castle!"

During battle: 
"Right, ! Let's do these guys in! Let's crush 'em into crumbs!"

When ordering to attack:
"It's time!"

When ordering to go to battle: 
To a kingdom:
"Stand back and behold Masanori! Here's how a true man fights!"
To a wild Pokémon location:
"Now we're talking! It's fighting time!"

Upon forming a link:
"Hey, guess what! I linked with !"

When using an item:
"Use my !"

When using his Warrior Skill:
"I'm gonna blow you away!"

After winning a battle:
If he attacked a castle:
"Yeahhh! Victory is ours!"
If he defended a castle:
"Wow! We're so good, I almost can't believe it!"

When defeated:
If recruitable:
"Yeah... You sure pack a powerful punch..."
If defeated by something other than the enemy:
"This is how it ends? You got to be kiddin' me."
Otherwise:
"What?! You gotta be kiddin'! My precious ...!"

When being recruited:
"Count yourself lucky to have a real man like Masanori at your service!"

===Profile===
A simpleminded soul brimming over with pure macho energy. Often gets into trouble from not thinking things through properly but is also in possession of a determined streak.

==In the manga==
===Pokémon + Nobunaga's Ambition ~ Ranse's Color Picture Scroll ~===
Masanori debuted in PNA1.
 
====Pokémon====
 

==Trivia==
Masanori has the lowest Wisdom of any Warlord.

===Historical origin===
Masanori is based on the real-life of Japanese history.
